title: Approval of the Second Amendment to Contract DA-5755 with Theodora Oringher PC: To extend the term by two (2) years, for new expiration date of July 17, 2029, covering legal advice and representation
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 9]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Second Amendment to Contract DA-5755 with Theodora Oringher PC: To extend the term by two (2) years, for new expiration date of July 17, 2029, covering legal advice and representation of Los Angeles World Airports in connection with public contracting, including construction litigation (Brian Ostler)
summary: A two-year extension, to July 17, 2029, of LAWA's legal services contract with Theodora Oringher PC covering public contracting matters, including construction litigation.
